X-VLA Object: L2-norm data N/A.',","          ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', fontstyle='italic')"," "," # Grid","-ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)","+ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.1, zorder=0)"," ax.set_axisbelow(True)"," "," plt.tight_layout()"]}],"originalFile":"import matplotlib\nmatplotlib.use('Agg')\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nimport matplotlib.patches as mpatches\nimport matplotlib.patheffects as pe\nimport numpy as np\nimport os\n\nplt.rcParams.update({\n    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',\n    'font.size': 10,\n    'axes.titlesize': 12,\n    'axes.labelsize': 11,\n    'xtick.labelsize': 10,\n    'ytick.labelsize': 9.5,\n    'legend.fontsize': 9,\n    'figure.dpi': 300,\n    'savefig.dpi': 300,\n    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',\n    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.1,\n    'axes.spines.top': False,\n    'axes.spines.right': False,\n})\n\n# ── Data ──\nsuites = ['Object', 'Spatial', 'Goal', 'Long-Horizon']\nmodel_order = [r'$\\pi$0.5', 'X-VLA', 'OpenVLA', 'SmolVLA']\ncv_map = {r'$\\pi$0.5': 0.055, 'X-VLA': 0.151, 'OpenVLA': 0.215, 'SmolVLA': 0.314}\n\ngap_data = {\n    r'$\\pi$0.5':  [24.2, 21.0,  8.2, 23.8],\n    'X-VLA':      [None,  1.4,  0.2,  1.2],\n    'OpenVLA':    [ 1.4,  4.8,  4.8,  3.2],\n    'SmolVLA':    [ 0.0,  0.0,  0.0,  0.0],\n}\n\n# Colors (Okabe-Ito)\ncolors = {\n    r'$\\pi$0.5':  '#D55E00',\n    'X-VLA':      '#0072B2',\n    'OpenVLA':    '#56B4E9',\n    'SmolVLA':    '#BBBBBB',\n}\n\n# ── Layout ──\nn_suites = len(suites)\nn_models = len(model_order)\nbar_w = 0.17\ngap_between = 0.035\nx_base = np.arange(n_suites) * 1.2  # wider spacing between groups\n\nfig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 5.0))\n\nfor mi, model in enumerate(model_order):\n    offset = (mi - (n_models - 1) / 2) * (bar_w + gap_between)\n    vals = gap_data[model]\n\n    for si in range(n_suites):\n        pos = x_base[si] + offset\n        val = vals[si]\n\n        if val is None:\n            t = ax.text(pos, 1.0, 'N/A', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7,\n                        color='#AAAAAA', fontstyle='italic')\n            t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])\n            continue\n\n        bar_kw = dict(width=bar_w, color=colors[model], zorder=2,\n                      edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6)\n\n        if model == 'SmolVLA':\n            bar_kw.update(alpha=0.30, hatch='///', edgecolor='#999999',\n                          linewidth=0.5)\n            display_h = 0.5\n        else:\n            bar_kw['alpha'] = 0.88\n            display_h = val\n\n        ax.bar(pos, display_h, **bar_kw)\n\n        # Value annotation with white stroke for readability\n        if val == 0:\n            t = ax.text(pos, display_h + 0.3, '0', ha='center', va='bottom',\n                        fontsize=7, color='#999999', fontstyle='italic')\n        else:\n            txt_color = colors[model]\n            t = ax.text(pos, val + 0.3, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom',\n                        fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color=txt_color)\n            t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])\n\n# ── Reference line at 2pp ──\nax.axhline(y=2, color='#BBBBBB', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, zorder=1)\nt = ax.text(x_base[-1] + 0.62, 2.0, '2 pp', fontsize=7.5, color='#AAAAAA',\n            ha='right', va='center', fontstyle='italic')\nt.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])\n\n# ── Axes ──\nax.set_xticks(x_base)\nax.set_xticklabels(suites, fontsize=10)\nax.set_ylabel(r'Method Gap (pp)    $|\\,\\mathrm{SR_{L2\\text{-}norm}} - \\mathrm{SR_{Random}}\\,|$',\n              fontsize=10)\nax.set_ylim(0, 28)\nax.set_xlim(x_base[0] - 0.55, x_base[-1] + 0.65)\n\n# Title\nax.set_title('Low CV amplifies pruning-method sensitivity',\n             fontsize=11.5, fontweight='medium', pad=12)\n\n# ── Legend with footnotes integrated ──\nhandles = []\nfor model in model_order:\n    kw = dict(facecolor=colors[model], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)\n    if model == 'SmolVLA':\n        kw.update(alpha=0.30, hatch='///', edgecolor='#999999')\n        label = f'{model}  (CV={cv_map[model]:.3f})  [collapsed]'\n    else:\n        kw.update(alpha=0.88)\n        label = f'{model}  (CV={cv_map[model]:.3f})'\n    handles.append(mpatches.Patch(**kw, label=label))\n\nax.legend(handles=handles, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.95,\n          edgecolor='#DDDDDD', fancybox=False, handlelength=1.4,\n          borderpad=0.6)\n\n# Footnote below x-axis\nfig.text(0.5, -0.02,\n         r'Gap = $|\\mathrm{SR_{L2\\text{-}norm}} - \\mathrm{SR_{Random}}|$ at $k$=0.95.'\n         '  OpenVLA Spatial/Goal/Long at $k$=0.9.  X-VLA Object: L2-norm data not available.',\n         ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', fontstyle='italic')\n\n# Grid\nax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)\nax.set_axisbelow(True)\n\nplt.tight_layout()\n\noutdir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\nplt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_method_gap.pdf', dpi=300)\nplt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_method_gap.png', dpi=150)\nplt.close()\nprint(f'Saved to {outdir}')\n","userModified":false}}
